source: Visible exact ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS, native keys, 2026-11-19
observations: Observed native PLUS: empty Results gives Math ERROR, single observation has sample variance/deviation blank at n=1; total frequency 0 keeps sums/n zero and other statistics blank.
Negative frequency input is rejected; RIGHT, SETTINGS and digits are ignored on the error. Back and EXE restore the exact draft and selected frequency cell. A second Back cancels the draft.

The list has twelve small cells. Scientific mantissas are truncated to fit, then redundant fractional zeros removed. Negative exponents use a lowered 10 and share its horizontal space with the sign. All exponent digits 0..9 captured.
For x=10000000001,10000000002,10000000003, population variance is 0.6666666667 and sample variance is 1; no subtraction cancellation is observed.

PLUS applies n-1 for fractional total frequency below one. A single value with n=0.5 displays sample variance/deviation 0. Values 1,2 with frequency 0.25 each display sample variance -0.25 and leave sample deviation blank.
